node.title: H3 nonidentity P24 gcd certificate
node.statement: Over every dyadic split row, let G_12 be the gcd of the unordered shifted-product polynomial and its first twelve Hasse derivatives, remove its complete T=1 factor, and let H_D be the gcd of the diagonal polynomial and its first Hasse derivative. Then max_(t!=1)P(t)<=24 if and only if G_12^neq divides H_D. The exact local valuations are (U-12)_+ and (D-1)_+, so the only retained rich profile is U=13,D=2,P=24. This is a certificate checker, not an official-row proof or polynomial-construction algorithm.
